reasoning.assessment: The trained XGBoost classifier predicts benign. Its closed-set model score is 99.2% (uncalibrated). A benign prediction does not establish that the device or network is safe. The largest displayed absolute SHAP contribution is network_packet-size_min (+2.447 raw margin units).
